newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EDP green shoe not yet exercised, but seen certain.
newsitem.headline: EDP green shoe not yet exercised, but seen certain.

text.p: The green shoe from the partial privatisation of utility group EDP-Electricidade de Portugal has not yet been exercised by the global coordinators but it is certain to be so within a month, EDP sources said.
"The exercising of the green shoe can be taken for granted. It is just a question of the coordinators doing it formally," said one source.
On Monday, bourse officials had told Reuters that the green shoe -- additional shares at the disposal of the coordinators for sale to institutional investors -- had already been used.

Banco Portugues de Investimento, one of the coordinating banks, gave out figures on Monday for the number of shares allotted to institutional investors which included the 16.36 million shares set aside for the green shoe.
But EDP officials said that formally no action had yet been taken and that under the terms of the privatisation the global coordinating banks have a month in which to take a decision.
Demand for shares at the privatisation, the largest so far carried out in Portugal, massively outstripped supply.
The stock soared 38 percent on the Lisbon bourse on Tuesday as disappointed investors sought to buy on the market shares they had failed to get at the privatisation.
